project_scope.note: This is the initial Papaveraceae family file for Hays Botany ID. Future Papaveraceae genera should be merged into this file rather than replacing it from scratch.

family_diagnostics.habit: Herbs in the current local study set.
family_diagnostics.sap: Latex is a high-value character in Argemone and should be observed cautiously without unnecessary damage.
family_diagnostics.flowers: Typically showy, radially symmetric flowers with separate petals and numerous stamens.
family_diagnostics.field_tip: In Argemone, flower color alone is weak. Latex color, sepal-horn structure, leaf prickles, and capsule prickles are much more diagnostic.
